learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn the names of our body parts and the fun actions they can do!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sing the song out loud and do the fun actions with your teacher. Make sure you clap your hands loudly!
Look in a mirror and touch your face. Point to your two big eyes, two cute ears, and one little nose.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Trace Your Beautiful Hands
fun_activity.instructions: Place your hand flat on a blank piece of paper. Ask your parents to help you draw around it with a bright crayon!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use our two little hands to clap and play.
⭐ We use our two little legs to tap and jump.
⭐ We have one little head that moves from side to side.
